name: Conservative Density Evaluation
definition: Conservative Density is an optimization added to the ray marching process to avoid evaluating the entirety of the cloud material graph for each sample, which would be too expensive. It uses a user-specified conservative density that is inexpensively reasonable to evaluate.
summary: Conservative Density Evaluation is a ray marching optimization that uses an inexpensive density check to gate expensive material graph evaluations, skipping computations when density is zero.
